name: Astro
art_prompt: a cheerful young woman astronaut with a slim feminine figure, narrow waist and graceful posture, wearing a fitted white spacesuit with bright orange stripes, orange gloves and chunky orange boots, a round glass bubble helmet with a completely dark tinted mirrored visor that shows no face at all, only faint reflections, a compact white backpack with a round orange air tank, standing straight with hands relaxed at the sides
motion: running in place at a light bouncy jog, arms and legs pumping, backpack bobbing
anim_hint: a slim woman astronaut in a white and orange spacesuit, her round helmet visor is a completely dark opaque black mirror with no face behind it
anim_negative: face, eyes, mouth, hair, a visible face inside the helmet, transparent visor
portrait_prompt: leaning in with a cheerful thumbs-up in an orange glove, the dark mirrored visor of her round helmet reflecting a tiny star and a planet
hurt_hint: her round helmet visor stays a completely dark opaque black mirror with no face behind it, the whole body tensing
trait_text: Gain 2 max HP per level, and heal 8% of max HP on every level-up.

AST-A.note: The outlaw's own painting, the look every player owns (pass 126 gave it a code so skins can stand beside it).

AST-B.note: pass 126: a black and gold spacesuit: Klein edits of her own paintings, view by view (tools/gen_skin_views.py), walked on her own driver

recipe.art_prompt: a slim young woman astronaut in a fitted glossy black spacesuit with bright gold stripes, gold gloves and chunky gold boots, a round black helmet with a gold rim around a completely dark opaque mirrored visor that shows no face at all, a compact black backpack, standing straight with hands relaxed at the sides
recipe.anim_hint: a slim woman astronaut in a glossy black and gold spacesuit, her round helmet visor is a completely dark opaque black mirror with no face behind it

AST-C.note: pass 126: her orange turned blue: a recolour of her strip, badge and cut-out (tools/skin_recolour.py)

AST-D.note: pass 141: Splashdown, Astro at the beach: a plain orange V-neck one-piece swimsuit, bare arms, legs and feet, and still her space helmet (Garry: "the funny twist"); Klein edits of her own paintings view by view (tools/gen_skin_views.py from AST-A; the back, fd and hurts as two-reference edits, tools/dl/p141/ART/scripts/edit_cands.py), walked on her run driver, the front on run_legs70 (the legs' swing x0.7, so the kicked-back foot stays behind the planted knee: Garry's third foot on AST-B); key_cut_shadow off (the shadow cut ate her pale bare feet and the outline drew shoes round the holes)

recipe.art_prompt: a slim young woman in a simple bright orange V-neck one-piece swimsuit, bare arms, bare legs and bare feet, no gloves and no shoes, still wearing a round white space helmet whose visor is a completely dark opaque mirror that shows no face at all, standing straight with hands relaxed at the sides
recipe.anim_hint: a slim woman in a bright orange V-neck one-piece swimsuit, barefoot: bare feet with toes, bare arms and bare legs, wearing a round white space helmet whose visor is a completely dark opaque black mirror with no face behind it
recipe.anim_negative: face, eyes, mouth, hair, a visible face inside the helmet, transparent visor, gloves, shoes, sneakers, trainers, sandals, socks, boots, footwear, shoe soles, a spacesuit, a backpack, a third leg, a third foot, an extra foot
recipe.hurt_hint: her round helmet visor stays a completely dark opaque black mirror with no face behind it, the whole body tensing
recipe.back_hint: She runs away from the viewer the whole time and never turns round: the plain white back of the round helmet, her bare back and the swimsuit's low V back, the backs of her legs and her heels.
